summary: Pull requests run the FAST test tier; the HEAVY end-to-end tier is proven in the merge queue (forced onto a pull request by the tier:heavy label or by listed paths); a FAST run signs a note that never satisfies the full gate

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes; this changes CI test selection scripts and docs.

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites.

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digests change.

compatibility.detail: No client, wire or harness contract change. CI only: what a green pull request check proves changes (FAST tier at the pull request head, HEAVY in the merge group), and the evidence note of a FAST run carries tier-fast in its command.

recovery.detail: No recovery procedure; remove the CI_TEST_TIER lines from the shard jobs to return to the whole selection on pull requests.
